headline: Tabled sewer adjustment requests for 35 View St. and 221 Greene St. until October 2026.
summary: Customers asked for sewer adjustments after high winter quarter reads at 35 View St., Unit B and 221 Greene St., Unit A. Both requests were tabled to October 2026 so procedures for adjusting sewer quarter reads can be re-evaluated. The meeting also approved the August 18, 2026 minutes and the August 2026 department reports.
decisions: Approved the August 18, 2026 regular meeting minutes, unanimously.
Approved the August 2026 department reports, unanimously.
Tabled sewer adjustment requests for 35 View St., Unit B and 221 Greene St., Unit A, to the October 2026 meeting, unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: On motion of Commissioner Ferrier and seconded; it was unanimously voted to approve the August 18, 2026 regular meeting minutes as presented.
On motion of Commissioner Porrini and seconded; it was unanimously voted to approve the August 2026 Department Reports as presented.
On motion of Commissioner Porrini and seconded; it was unanimously to table 35 View St. and 221 Greene St. to the October 2026 meeting.

decision_titles: Sewer adjustment requests for 35 View St. and 221 Greene St.
